No. - 8462 of 2020 has been filed by the accused applicant seeking anticipatory bail in anticipation of his arrest in Case Crime No. 340 of 2019, under Sections 420,
409, 467, 468, 471, 201 and 120-B I.P.C., Police Station Dadri, District Gautam Budh Nagar;

Criminal Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application U/s 438 CR.P.C. No. - 8534 of 2020 has been filed by the accused applicant seeking anticipatory bail in anticipation of his arrest in Case Crime No. 602 of 2019, under Sections 420, 409, 467, 468, 471, 201 and 120-B I.P.C., Police Station Dadri, District Gautam Budh Nagar; Criminal Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application U/s 438 CR.P.C. No. - 1977 of 2021 has been filed by the accused applicant seeking anticipatory bail in anticipation of his arrest in Case Crime No. 592 of 2019, under Sections 420, 409, 467, 468, 471, 201 and 120-B I.P.C. and R.B.
Act, Police Station Dadri, District Gautam Budh Nagar.
3. The present applications seeking anticipatory bail have remained pending before this Court since 2020 without there being any interim protection granted to the accused applicant.

4. Thousands of investors were cheaed by the accused applicant in the name of an scheme in which the investors were allured to make investment of Rs.62,100/- per vehicle on which the investors were assured to receive Rs.9,765/- for a period of twelve months.
Several persons looking at the lucrative scheme invested their hard earned huge amount and the accused applicant misappropriated the said amounts.
In the investigation, it has been found that around Rs.3500 crores received from the public in general got misappropriate by the accused applicant and other co-accused.

5. Looking at the gigantic fraud committed by the accused applicant by cheating several thousands innocent investors misappropriating 3500 crores of rupees invested by them, this Court does not find it a case where the Court can put any indulgence to the accused applicant and grant him anticipatory bail.
6. Thus, there being no merit and substance in these anticipatory bail applications, these are hereby rejected.
